chunks: And Safwan ibn Yahya narrated from Al-'Is ibn Al-Qasim, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who bought a slave who had children from a free woman, and then he freed him.
He عليه السلام said: "The wala' of his children belongs to the one who freed him."

key_terms.أَوْلَادٌ: children born to the slave from a free woman
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a male slave who was owned and then emancipated
key_terms.وَلَاءُ: the legal bond of loyalty and affiliation connected to emancipation

ai.seo_question: Who holds the wala' of a freed slave's children in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding wala' in the case of a slave who had children from a free woman and was later emancipated. Imam Abu 'Abdillah عليه السلام states that the bond of wala' of his children is assigned to the one who freed the father.
